object.attr: derived: `commit_changes` without `paths` commits each uncommitted document file, a person's edits too, and the agent can't see which (CF-M40). Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-M3); whether `paths` becomes required is open, for VER.
object.description: When the MCP server makes a commit, the MCP server shall return the path of each file that the commit changed.
